purpose.domain_detail: Hospital/healthcare personnel management system - transferring work schedule plan (plan de travail) to hours records per cost center/service (postes de frais / netto-service). French: 'HOPJOUR' = hôpital jours (hospital days).
purpose.summary: Program 7-HPJ transfers work schedule plan data into hours records for hospital cost centers and services. It processes employee records, calculates worked hours including night-rate tariffs, manages absences, and writes/deletes records in HEURES (hours) and JOURS (days) files. It includes an interactive screen for selecting parameters such as employee group, cost center, and detail options.

notable_features: ACUCOBOL-style ACCEPT/DISPLAY screen I/O with LINE/POSITION/SIZE/TAB/UPDATE/NO BEEP/CURSOR
CALL 'C$RERR' for extended file error handling
32 COPY statements for modular record/file definitions
Box-drawing characters in comments (IBM CP850 encoding)
